title: Alisa Clairmont/Quotes
summary:
"Do you not realise who I am?! I am Miss Alisa Clairmont and I am here every year."
- Alisa Clairmont to Sophie Casterwill (All Work and No Pay)

"You obviously don't like dogs. He can sense it."
- Alisa Clairmont to Lok Lambert, after her dog bites him (All Work and No Pay)

"Go on, baby! You show the mean man!"
- Alisa Clairmont o her dog and LeBlanche (All Work and No Pay)
